Author: Muse
Description: Exports the logged-in character's job/class levels, Cosmic Exploration (cosmic tool) progress, saved gearsets and currently equipped items to a per-character JSON file (ffxiv-status-<Character>-<World>.json) in this plugin's config folder, so multiple characters never overwrite each other. Writes on login, when the data changes, every 5 minutes while logged in, and on demand with /mstatus. Also records incoming /tell messages (sender and text, newest 200) to ffxiv-tells-<Character>-<World>.json in the same folder. Since v1.5.0 the snapshot also includes currencies, inventory containers (bags, armoury chest, saddlebags, summoned retainer's bags), retainer venture state, Grand Company supply/provisioning requests, and housing visit history. Since v1.8.0 it can also apply plugin configuration files sent by Muse through the uploader (config-inbox folder): targets are validated and backed up, an expected-hash guard prevents overwriting local changes, a loaded target plugin is reloaded via /xldisableplugin and /xlenableplugin, and outcomes are written to ffxiv-config-results.json. Since v1.9.0 it also keeps the Halone Earring (item 52439, EXP +30% at levels 1-100) equipped while a battle class/job in that range is active, whenever the earring is in the bags or armoury chest, and reports HaloneEarringEquipped in the snapshot. Since v1.10.0 every feature (status export, currencies, inventory, retainers, GC supply capture, housing visits, tell recording, config downlink, Halone Earring auto-equip) has its own checkbox in the plugin's configuration window; all default to on. Since v1.11.0 the snapshot also includes main scenario quest progress (MainScenario: currently accepted MSQ, next MSQ, last completed MSQ, and per-expansion completion counts), derived from the journal's main-scenario section, the accepted-quest list and QuestManager.IsQuestComplete. Since v1.12.0 the snapshot also includes shared FATE progress (FateProgress: per-zone current rank, completed FATE count and count needed for the next rank, for all three expansions that have shared FATEs), read from AgentFateProgress; the last readable state is kept in a per-character sidecar file (mstatus-fateprogress-<Character>-<World>.json), because the agent only holds data after the FATE progress window has been opened once since login. Since v1.12.2 the plugin also requests the shared FATE progress itself, Auto FATE Grind style: each zone's completed count is backed by a hidden achievement, so it asks the server for the per-tab FATE progress (Achievement.RequestFateProgressTab) and every zone achievement's progress (main command 1000), records the answers through a hook on Achievement.ReceiveAchievementProgress, and derives the ranks from the per-expansion rank sizes (6+60 for Shadowbringers/Endwalker, 6+20+40 for Dawntrail); the FATE progress window no longer has to be opened. Since v1.12.3 the Halone Earring auto-equip no longer fires at the level cap: the v1.9.1 condition tested GetClassJobNeededExp <= 0 as 'at cap', but that value is 29,023,000 at level 100 (the next level's requirement), not 0, so the earring was wrongly equipped on a level-100 Warrior; the check now uses PlayerState.GetCurrentClassJobMaxLevel (the cap of the job being played, which also covers the limited jobs' lower caps) plus the level < 100 rule. Since v1.12.4 the agent-sourced FATE progress values are normalized to the achievement path's shape (cumulative completed count out of 66, remainder to the next rank, ranks from 1, real max rank): the agent natively reports the count inside the current rank band, the band's total size as NeededFates, rank 0 for untouched zones and MaxRank 0, which made the two sources disagree. Since v1.13.0 the snapshot also includes the chocobo companion (buddy) state (Buddy: name, rank, current EXP, the current rank's max EXP when known, skill points, and LevelUpReady when the EXP bar is full below the rank cap of 20), read from UIState.Buddy.CompanionInfo and the Buddy window's number array, with the last known max EXP kept in a per-character sidecar file (mstatus-buddy-<Character>-<World>.json). Since v1.14.0 the snapshot also includes weekly limited-tomestone progress (WeeklyTomestone: acquired count and weekly limit from InventoryManager's native counters), daily duty-roulette completion state (RouletteCompletion: the raw PlayerState.ContentRouletteCompletion bytes plus per-roulette entries pairing ContentRoulette row ids with the bytes), per-character play time (PlayTime: session start/elapsed, today's total and recent daily totals, kept in mstatus-playtime-<Character>-<World>.json), an experimental Grand Company agent probe (GcAgentProbe: whether AgentGrandCompanySupply holds the daily list without any window being opened), and retainer market-board state (each retainer's listed-item count and listing expiry, plus the summoned retainer's listings with unit prices, kept in mstatus-retainermarket-<Character>-<World>.json). The plugin can also print in-game chat notifications when a retainer venture completes, when the buddy becomes ready to level up, and when a new daily GC supply list is captured (announced once per event; state in mstatus-alerts-<Character>-<World>.json). Six more feature checkboxes were added to the settings window.
Name: Muse Status Exporter
Punchline: Writes job levels, Cosmic Exploration progress, gearsets, currencies, inventory, retainers, GC supply requests, housing visits, main scenario progress, shared FATE progress and chocobo companion (buddy) rank/EXP to a per-character JSON file; records incoming tells; applies plugin configs sent by Muse; keeps the Halone EXP earring equipped while leveling; every feature toggleable in the settings window (v1.14.0). Since v1.12.1 the main scenario detection matches the journal sections by RowId (0/1) and name prefix, because the section names carry expansion suffixes (e.g. "メインクエスト1（新生・蒼天・紅蓮・漆黒・暁月）") that the v1.11.0 exact match missed, which left MainScenario empty.
